notes: Captured from scratch threads created and archived by the Step 0 probes; no user data.
A pending user question leaves the thread status 'running'; pendingRequestCount on the thread detail becomes > 0.
Run status 'waiting' is treated by T3 itself as running; approvals are pending requests that t3_pending_request does not list.
Interrupting a running turn ends with thread status 'cancelled' or 'interrupted' depending on timing (both observed live).
Archiving also settles; archived threads disappear from t3_thread_list.
clientRequestId makes t3_thread_launch and t3_thread_send idempotent (same threadId / runId returned).
401 WWW-Authenticate carries resource_metadata unless the presented token is non-empty without a '.', and error="invalid_token" whenever a token was presented; real MCP client tokens contain a '.'.
Phase 2 samples were captured 2026-11-09 from the same T3 Code version by an MCP client signed in from outside a thread with a full-access token.
t3_project_create ignores defaultModelSelection (the result is always null); set it with t3_project_update, which stores {instanceId, model} plus options and drops provider.
schedule_task needs a project with a default model; outside callers are never bound (boundThreadId null); clientRequestId makes creation idempotent.

run_scheduled_task_now works on disabled tasks, starts a new full-access thread in the task's project, and reports lastRunStatus 'succeeded' once started; a project folder that is not a git repository fails workspace preparation at once.
Deleting a project with threads needs force: true; the folder on disk stays.
orchestrator_capabilities providers and models are trimmed here; the real catalog lists more of both.
